hypothesis: A user-level Daphnie profile, bounded shared notes and source-to-change logs can transfer useful learning across projects without importing unrelated goals or private data.
reason: Useful bounded architecture; require selective sharing, verified scheduling scope and no infrastructure expansion.

supportingEvidence.claim: Separates private knowledge, project outcomes and attribution; prohibits unrelated-chat scanning and forced changes.

contraryEvidence.claim: Infrastructure work substantially exceeded budget without demonstrated efficiency gains; keep this implementation minimal.

unknowns: Cross-project retrieval quality and maintenance cost.
Actual scheduled delivery into this chat.
Execution while the laptop sleeps; local scheduling cannot guarantee wake or recovery.
No guaranteed model identity, universal chat access or web/mobile portability.

prediction.ifTrue: A fresh project retrieves a relevant sanitized lesson while preserving its own goals and private boundaries.
prediction.ifFalse: Retrieval imports wave assumptions, leaks private material, misattributes changes or adds recurring overhead without useful synthesis.

test.action: Validate the skill; run one unrelated scratch-project probe; inspect schedule, timezone and destination; audit one source-to-change entry and public diff.
test.success: Relevant retrieval, no wave-goal leakage, article instructions treated as untrusted content, no private paths/content published; proposed versus applied credit remains explicit. Configuration alone is not delivery evidence.
test.failure: Boundary leakage, unsupported continuity claims, retroactive attribution or budget exhaustion. Defer optional features.

schemaNormalization: Reviewer returned its identity under reviewer.id; lead normalized that key to agentId without changing the identity or decision.
